fn apply(acc: Int, x: Int) -> Int
  requires acc >= 0
  ensures result >= 0
  ensures not (x >= 0) or result == acc + x
  ensures not (x < 0 and acc + x < 0) or result == acc
  ensures not (x < 0 and acc + x >= 0) or result == acc + x
  effects pure
  example apply(10, -3) == 7
  example apply(7, -20) == 7
  example apply(0, -5) == 0
  example apply(7, 5) == 12
{
  if x < 0 and acc + x < 0 then acc else acc + x
}

fn run(xs: List[Int], acc: Int) -> Int
  requires acc >= 0
  ensures result >= 0
  ensures not (len(xs) == 0) or result == acc
  ensures not (forall x in xs: x >= 0) or result >= acc
  effects pure
  example run([], 4) == 4
  example run([10, -3, -20, 5], 0) == 12
  example run([-5, 2], 0) == 2
{
  match xs {
    [] => acc
    [h, ..t] => run(t, apply(acc, h))
  }
}

fn balance(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: x != 0
  ensures result >= 0
  ensures result == run(xs, 0)
  effects pure
  example balance([10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12
  example balance([-5, 2]) == 2
  example balance([]) == 0
  example balance([-1, -2]) == 0
  example balance([5, -5, -1]) == 0

fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires len(xs) >= 0
  ensures result == contains(xs, x)
  effects pure
  example has([1, 4, 6], 4) == true
  example has([1, 4, 6], 5) == false
  example has([], 1) == false
{
  match xs {
    [] => false
    [h, ..t] => h == x or has(t, x)
  }
}

fn nth_is(xs: List[Int], i: Int, x: Int) -> Bool
  requires i >= 0
  ensures result == (i < len(xs) and xs[i] == x)
  effects pure
  example nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 4) == true
  example nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 6) == false
  example nth_is([1, 4, 6], 3, 6) == false
  example nth_is([], 0, 1) == false
{
  match xs {
    [] => false
    [h, ..t] => if i == 0 then h == x else nth_is(t, i - 1, x)
  }
}

fn found_ok(xs: List[Int], x: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires len(xs) >= 0
  ensures not result or (contains(xs, x) == (r != None))
  ensures not result or (forall i in 0..len(xs): (xs[i] == x) == (r == Some(i)))
  effects pure
  example found_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(2)) == true
  example found_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, None) == true
  example found_ok([1, 4], 4, Some(0)) == false
  example found_ok([1, 4], 4, None) == false
  example found_ok([1, 4], 7, Some(5)) == false
{
  match r {
    None => not has(xs, x)
    Some(i) => i >= 0 and nth_is(xs, i, x)
  }
}
